description: A sweet black-and-white snapshot capturing an infant identified as 'Rita Jr.' propped up on a small white blanket with a matching pillow in a lush, grassy backyard bordered by dense garden shrubbery. The child wears a light-colored baby gown and smiles toward the camera on a sunny day.
